applicability: Parshall flume used as a control section with a rectangular section having a trapezoidal bottom; the variations in velocity at maximum and minimum flow conditions from the designed velocity of flow should be within permissible limits.
notes: Printed denominator is 1000bD with no multiplication signs; retained.
The partially visible '(5.20)' at the top right of the source crop is the number of the preceding Equation 5.20, printed below that equation; Equation 5.21's own number is printed below this formula.

transcription.observations: First visual transcription only. Every printed glyph, power, subscript, inequality, unit, hyphen spacing, footnote and printed error was read from the rendered source and retained or flagged; no value inferred.
